deploy: bash -euo pipefail -c 'set -a; source ./bosh.env; set +a; bosh create-release --force && bosh upload-release && bosh -n -d juicefs deploy manifests/juicefs.yml'
vendor-go: bash -euo pipefail -c 'cd src/juicefs; go mod vendor; mkdir -p ../juicefs-deps; rm -rf ../juicefs-deps/vendor; mv vendor ../juicefs-deps/vendor'
